# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"a furnace variant","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a furnace variant introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / lcc:0.4.3"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_stars:0.2.0"}}. It is similar to the vanilla {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:smoker"}} and {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:blast_furnace"}}, being a faster but more limited {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:furnace"}}, but the {{"of":"self"}} only smelts items that cannot be smoked or blasted.

# Usage
The {{"of":"self"}} has the same interface as any {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:furnace"}}, smelting an item in the top slot using fuel from the bottom slot.

Like {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:smoker","plural":true}} and {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:blast_furnace","plural":true}}, {{"of":"self","plural":true}} smelt items (and consume fuel) at double the rate of a standard {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:furnace"}}.

Only items that **can** be smelted in a {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:furnace"}}, but **cannot** be smelted in a {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:smoker"}}, {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:blast_furnace"}} or {{"of":"minecraft:block / minecraft:campfire"}} will be processed in a {{"of":"self"}}.
